pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with high-frequency, serrated edge gradients; patches exhibit internal color variation from medium to dark tan with sharp pixel transitions at the margins.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Complex non-uniform lattice of light cream-colored pathways; junction nodes are clearly visible where three to four patches converge; pixel thickness of corridors varies significantly across the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency sawtooth silhouette along the dorsal line of the neck and shoulder region.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct structural break in the mane line is observed at the point of contact with an avian subject perched on the ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a brown avian organism (Buphagus species) perched on the mid-dorsal ridge; distinct vertical skin-folding visible in the axillary/shoulder transition zone.
